verify.label: columns of coupons
verify.sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default IS NOT NULL AS has_default, is_identity, numeric_precision, numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'coupons' ORDER BY ordinal_position

verify.label: primary key of coupons
verify.sql: SELECT a.attname FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (i.indkey) WHERE i.indrelid = 'public.coupons'::regclass AND i.indisprimary
